_about: Public-domain A. A. Hodge (Archibald Alexander Hodge, 1823-1886, Princeton Seminary professor, son of Charles Hodge) for the Word Hoard: Outlines of Theology in the rewritten and enlarged edition (New York: Carter, 1879), A Commentary on the Confession of Faith (the 1885 new edition of the 1869 book), The Atonement (1867), Popular Lectures on Theological Themes (1887) and The Life of Charles Hodge (New York: Scribner, 1880), raw Internet Archive OCR. Added 2026-10-03 by lane A, round 10 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted. Extended 2026-10-28 by lane A at Adam's request (his Logos author list): Manual of Forms for baptism, the Lord's Supper, marriage and funerals, Questions on the Text of the Systematic Theology of Dr. Charles Hodge, and a funeral address of 1881.

aa-hodge-outlines-1879: Outlines of Theology, rewritten and enlarged (New York: R. Carter, 1879)
aa-hodge-atonement-1867: The Atonement (Philadelphia: Presbyterian Board of Publication, 1867)
aa-hodge-popular-lectures-1887: Popular Lectures on Theological Themes (Philadelphia: Presbyterian Board of Publication, 1887)
aa-hodge-life-charles-hodge-1880: The Life of Charles Hodge (New York: C. Scribner's Sons, 1880)
aa-hodge-confession-1885: A Commentary on the Confession of Faith, new edition with two appendices (Philadelphia: Presbyterian Board of Publication; author's preface dated June 1885; copyright line 1869, the catalogued year)
aa-hodge-manual-of-forms: Manual of forms, for baptism, admission to the communion, administration of the Lord's Supper, marriage and funerals, ordination of elders and deacons, etc (Philadelphia : Presbyterian Board of Publication and Sabbath-School Work, 1920)
aa-hodge-questions-systematic: Questions on the text of the Systematic Theology of Dr. Charles Hodge : together with an exhibition of various schemes illustrating the principles of theological construction (New York : Charles Scribner's Sons, 1885)
aa-hodge-funeral-address-1881: Address at the funeral of the Rev. Henry Augustus Boardman, D.D (Philadelphia : [s.n.], 1881)

_alternates.aa-hodge-outlines-1860: Outlines of Theology, first edition (New York: R. Carter, 1860), IA outlinesoftheolo1860hodg: the shorter text the 1879 edition rewrote

_excluded.aa-hodge-shorter-catechism: The System of Theology contained in the Westminster Shorter Catechism (1888): catalogued under A. A. and J. A. Hodge jointly
_excluded.aa-hodge-theism-evolution: Theism and Evolution (1886) is J. S. Van Dyke's book; Hodge wrote only the introduction
_excluded.aa-hodge-x-joint: Inspiration (1881) and the Westminster Doctrine anent Holy Scripture are written jointly with Warfield
_excluded.aa-hodge-x-others: The Substance of Four Sermons on Infant Baptism, the Lecture Notes of Archibald Alexander and the 1917 commission report are not his books
_excluded.aa-hodge-x-index: the Index to Systematic Theology is an index to his father's book
_excluded.aa-hodge-x-dups: earlier printings of the Outlines of Theology and other copies of the books held
